data.name: Don't Die on the Clock
data.detailed_description:
STREAM LIFE IS TOUGH

Being a cutie takes effort. But signing up to be in an extremely dangerous drug cartel just for that sweet, sweet internet attention? That is where things take a turn into true chaos!

Get ready for the ultimate co-op game experience for 1-4 players! You and your team of influencer ladies wanted to make the ultimate collaboration, so you signed the contract with the underground.

Now, you have no choice but to play this deadly two-fold game: you need to launder your Cartel Money Quota and keep your Stream Follower Quota right on track at the same time. Miss either of those, and the game ends.

THE CORE OF THE MADNESS

  • The Compelling Reason: You weren't kidnapped. You weren't coerced into anything. You girls actually joined a cartel for clout and views! And now you're streaming the entire operation. Entertain the audience with crazy stunts, wreck the store, and earn extra income to cover the damage.

  • The Double-Quota Trap: You are pursuing two objectives every day. You need to make sure your bosses get their clean money, and you need to satisfy your online fans with dangerous content. Zero views on your stream mean game over. Falling short of your cartel quota... well, your most recent video will appear on another less comfortable website...

YOUR NEW PETS

Forget those corporate executives; your boss is an ancient and tyrannical feline God who gets furious easily. He cares nothing about your stream views-he desires satisfaction.

  • Feline Demonic Management: Worship and satisfy the supernatural cats who serve as both your masters and the defenders of your turf. Please them with offerings or face the wrath of warped realities while you raid.

    Drip, Clout & Tactical Style: Give your killing machines the accessories to make them more chaotic. In this city, an adorable accessory is not only for clout but your destiny.

IT MIGHT NOT BE LEGAL, BUT IT WORKS!

Your rival assassins will be unconcerned with the beauty of your store. When they come barging into your shop to take your money, protect your area with pure and destructible physics!

  • Weapons of Imagination: Pick up whatever you can find. Throw the boxes, destroy the shelves, and use your water bottle as a suppressor.

  • Upgrade Your E-Girl Lair: Use your ill-gotten gains to upgrade your shop and hideaway.

FEATURES

  • 🥳 1-4 Player Online Co-op: Play with friends or play by yourself (assuming you are confident enough to take on it by yourself).

  • 🐱 Demonic Management: Feed the demonic cat to avoid reality-warping penalties.

  • 🪓 100% Destructible Shop Physics: Smash everything to pieces during wild fights.

  • 🎧 Streamer Customization: Look cute as you lose. Unlock masks, emotes, and cat-eared headsets.

  • 🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat: Panic and scream as your friend accidentally blows up the shop.

data.short_description: A chaotic 1-4 player online co-op shopkeeper sim where you play as streamer girls laundering money for the cartel! Survive shifts filled with pure daily madness. Manage the store, satisfy a demanding demonic cat, hit your quota, and fight off rival hitmen using destructible physics!
